Trigger inventory:

- `genie update` — `src/genie-commands/update.ts` imports `runAgentSync` (`src/genie-commands/update.ts:30`) and executes the sync via `runAgentSyncSafe` (`src/genie-commands/update.ts:2688-2692`). This is the normal post-update convergence trigger.
- `genie install` — `src/genie-commands/install.ts:53` imports `runAgentSyncSafe` and wires it as the default `sync` seam at `src/genie-commands/install.ts:330`, so install drives sync through the update module.
- `genie setup` — `src/genie-commands/setup.ts:12` imports `acquireLifecycleLease` from `src/lib/agent-sync.js`; it acquires the agent-sync lifecycle lock before Codex activation but does not itself run skill sync.
- `genie doctor` — read-only freshness checks only; `src/genie-commands/doctor.ts:44` imports agent-sync helpers and reuses the managed-dir contract (`src/genie-commands/doctor.ts:886` comment).
- `genie uninstall` — `src/genie-commands/uninstall.ts:61` imports removal helpers/backup root allocation and removes managed assets, e.g. `allocateExclusiveBackupRoot` usage at `src/genie-commands/uninstall.ts:1721`.
- Bundled `bin/genie` entry — minified `runManualUpdateConvergence` / lock helpers mirror these flows (`bin/genie:230`, `bin/genie:413`).
- `install.sh` — references the agent-sync lock lifecycle at `install.sh:201`, `install.sh:212`, `install.sh:239`, `install.sh:277` for fallback/steal/recovery but is not a sync caller.
- Plugin/source side — `plugins/genie/scripts/council-stamp.cjs:23` writes the same `MANAGED_BY = 'genie-agent-sync'` marker used by the sync engine.
